upstream_pin.version_boundary: Vapor 4 stable only; Vapor 5 beta is excluded from this plan

constructs.invariant: A PathComponent built from API_PREFIX cannot be projected to a single path without environment binding.
A route can be registered yet return unauthorized through route-group middleware; route existence is not successful response evidence.
RouteCollection.boot routes exist only after the collection is registered with the application.
The ** catchall consumes one or more remaining components and cannot be reduced to one :parameter segment.

runtime_oracle_plan.toolchain: Pin exact Swift 6 toolchain, SwiftPM resolved graph/checksums and Vapor 4.122.3 on a T20-approved isolated runner
steps: Verify the 4.122.3 Git tag/commit, six upstream source hashes, Swift tools 6.0 declaration and exact SwiftPM dependency resolution before building.

Materialize the normal and four counterexamples as separate Swift packages; run swift package resolve and swift test in an isolated, resource-approved runner, retaining Package.resolved, compiler diagnostics and toolchain identity.
Capture app.routes.all and the Vapor routes command after each configuration, including collection registration and middleware grouping; compare with source expectations.

Use VaporTesting with in-memory requests for normal GET/POST and unmatched methods, two API_PREFIX values, missing/present x-token, collection paths and catchall zero/one/multiple suffixes; capture method, path, status, body and route evidence.
Obtain T08 Swift language-profile review, T16 independent read and T19 mutation review before any static extractor or support claim.
Evaluate an HTTP leaf/bridge only after T00 authorizes composition; catalog admission and this plan do not remove the T08-05 block.

limits: These Swift files are hand-authored planning fixtures, not upstream source copies, compiled routes or executed requests.
Vapor 5 beta is outside the pinned 4.122.3 scope; the T13 catalog admission remains DEFER_UNTIL_PROFILE_REVIEW and is not support.
No Swift parser, Vapor extractor, adapter, registry, CLI path or shared-schema projection is added; T08-05 HTTP composition remains BLOCKED.
No SwiftPM build, VaporTesting request probe, independent attestation or release gate is exercised here.
